notice: Code review and research; not a certification of every engine version or game.

profiles.name: Generic files
profiles.versions: Coverage depends on the file format
profiles.commonIssue: Proprietary engine logic is not detected automatically.
missing: Add a parser for each required format
Verify round trips and exclude code and machine configuration

profiles.name: ChoiceScript
profiles.commonIssue: Commands and indentation control choices and flow.
missing: Implement a scene parser that preserves commands and variables
Test choices after translation

profiles.name: Cocos Creator / Cocos2d-x
profiles.commonIssue: Scripts may be compiled or distributed as .jsc.
missing: Validate versions and resource references
Do not claim encrypted script coverage without verified extraction

profiles.name: Construct
profiles.versions: Versions 2 and 3; projects and exports differ
profiles.coverage: Extracts readable data; writes an additional translation file
profiles.commonIssue: Creating a JSON file does not ensure the game loads it.
missing: Integrate loading of the generated translation file
Validate exports and the internationalization plugin

profiles.name: Defold
profiles.versions: Loose files and compiled exports differ
profiles.commonIssue: Fonts need the required glyphs; compiled data needs specific handling.
missing: Support compiled files and collections
Validate placeholders and fonts in runtime

profiles.name: Electron / HTML5
profiles.cheats: Depends on the game bridge; no universal editor
profiles.commonIssue: Context isolation and missing Node integration prevent older hooks.
missing: Test ASAR, preload, and DOM without disabling global isolation
Validate current versions as well as legacy versions

profiles.name: GameMaker
profiles.versions: Studio and recent versions need compatible tools
profiles.coverage: External text; data.win needs specific integration
profiles.commonIssue: Bytecode and YYC are not interchangeable formats.
missing: Integrate and verify a data.win tool for each supported version
Test format round trips and YYC runtime

profiles.name: GDevelop
profiles.commonIssue: Texts in events and extensions may be outside scene objects.
missing: Cover events, global objects, and external resources
Test exports without game.json

profiles.name: Godot
profiles.coverage: Resource bridge, CSV/PO, and compatible packages
profiles.commonIssue: Translations must be loaded or registered; fonts and locale affect display.
missing: Test PCK and imported resources by version
Verify PO/plural loading and font fallback

profiles.name: Kirikiri 2 / Z
profiles.versions: Separate Kirikiri 2, Z, x86, and x64 profiles
profiles.coverage: Native hook selection; dedicated parser incomplete
profiles.cheats: Requires a compatible hook; not verified in this review
profiles.commonIssue: UTF-8/Shift-JIS and script variants need correct decoding.
missing: Implement KAG/TJS and XP3 parsing by variant
Test fonts and variables in a real game

profiles.name: Pixel Game Maker MV
profiles.commonIssue: The name MV does not mean the RPG Maker MV pipeline is compatible.
missing: Implement a dedicated data and runtime adapter
Validate component version and architecture

profiles.name: Ren’Py
profiles.cheats: Variables require the RenPy bridge; RPG Maker commands do not apply
profiles.commonIssue: Updates may change identifiers, compilation, GUI, and Python APIs.
missing: Validate RPYC/RPA extraction by version
Test interpolation, tags, fonts, and variable persistence

profiles.name: RPG Developer Bakin
profiles.coverage: MTool reference; no verified dedicated coverage
profiles.commonIssue: A feature listed by MTool is not evidence of OpenTranslator support.
missing: Implement a dedicated detector and resource parser
Validate translation loading, fonts, and save/load

profiles.name: RPG Maker MV / MZ
profiles.versions: MV and MZ; runtime and plugin versions differ
profiles.coverage: JSON data and JavaScript runtime bridge
profiles.cheats: Gold, variables, HP/MP, and inventory depend on the active bridge
profiles.commonIssue: Plugins, escape codes, and NW.js versions can change runtime behavior.
missing: Test MV/MZ versions and plugin combinations separately
Validate escape codes, fonts, save/load, and gameplay cheats

profiles.name: RPG Maker XP / VX / VX Ace
profiles.coverage: Ruby Marshal bridge and RGSS archives
profiles.cheats: Native hooks depend on architecture; separate from the MV/MZ overlay
profiles.commonIssue: RTP, DLLs, and encoding must match the game engine.
missing: Validate Marshal and archives by generation
Check RTP and fonts without replacing arbitrary DLLs

profiles.name: SMILE GAME BUILDER
profiles.commonIssue: A feature listed by MTool is not evidence of OpenTranslator support.
missing: Implement a dedicated detector and parser
Validate resources, translations, and saves

profiles.name: SRPG Studio
profiles.coverage: Specific native hook; no complete dedicated pipeline
profiles.commonIssue: Engine detection does not prove translation or attribute editing.
missing: Add a dedicated adapter and authorized fixtures
Validate fonts, save/load, and hooks by architecture

profiles.name: TyranoBuilder / TyranoScript
profiles.versions: Identify the engine version and export type
profiles.commonIssue: Scenario tags and fonts must not be treated as plain text.
missing: Implement a scenario parser that preserves tags
Test exports and multilingual display

profiles.name: Unity
profiles.versions: Mono and IL2CPP are different profiles
profiles.commonIssue: IL2CPP, TMP, and fonts require a compatible loader/plugin combination.
missing: Check BepInEx/IL2CPP and architecture before installation
Test TMP, rich text, and text created after scene loading

profiles.name: Unreal Engine
profiles.coverage: LocRes with preserved hashes; packages need external tooling
profiles.commonIssue: Loaded locale, hashes, and package priority affect translations.
missing: Test IoStore and newer package versions
Validate fonts, text in images, and strings outside LocRes

profiles.name: Visual Novel Maker
profiles.commonIssue: No dedicated integration; do not confuse with RenPy or Tyrano.
missing: Map formats and versions
Create extraction/application fixtures and runtime tests

profiles.name: Wolf RPG Editor
profiles.cheats: Automatic hook disabled without a reliable version signature
profiles.commonIssue: Legacy encodings and different archive formats can corrupt text.
missing: Detect the actual archive version and encoding
Test repacking and fonts without selecting DLLs by executable size
